h1: A PrestaShop audit with a ranked list of fixes
overview: We review your PrestaShop store the way a shopper and a developer would. We check the version and module list, security settings, speed, mobile display, product pages, checkout and basic search setup. You receive a written report where every finding is ranked by impact and effort, with screenshots and plain fix steps. If you like, we go through it together on a one to one call.

faq: Will you fix what you find?
The audit is a report. You can hand it to your own developer or order one of our fix packages for the items you pick. The report is yours either way.
A back office profile with view rights is enough for most checks. We change nothing during an audit and never ask for your password.
Can you tell if my store is outdated?
Yes. We note your version, which modules and themes are behind, and which ones are no longer maintained, so you can plan updates sensibly.
Do you test for hacking attempts?
We check settings and known risky modules. A full penetration test is a separate specialist job and not part of this audit. We say so clearly in the report.
